proposition.claim:
Finite H-orbit bound and universal periodicity for biinfinite lines with noncyclic finite-segment stabilizers.

General induced normal form is uniformly quasigeodesic without compactness.

Deck(p)=Z alone gives finite Z-domain for cover of finite complex.

Terminal complexity (0,0) characterizes finite cyclic endpoint.
